findings.reason: The Definition promises an immersed disk with the grope's framed attaching region but does not specify its target. Behrens et al., Definition 12.12, places the disk in the grope block (D² ↪ Gᶜ(1.5)). The tower lemma uses that target in Facts F2 and §1.117, and the cyclic-group proof uses it in §§1.1–2.1. State the target and attaching-region framing explicitly on this Definition.

The Definition allows regular sheets to be merely topological embeddings and does not clearly assign each disk its boundary normal framing. The good-groups theorem uses locally flat boundary and framing germs in §1.1, invokes the locally-flat-link supplier there, and compares standard sheet charts in §5.1. Powell–Ray–Teichner §6 defines topological generic immersions by the smooth generic local models, which are locally flat at single-image points, and specifies the boundary-frame convention. Make these conditions explicit without requiring the relative framing obstruction to vanish.
